create table t (id int primary key, v int)
create table u (id int primary key, w int)
create table w (id int primary key, x int)
create materialized view log on t (v)
create materialized view log on u (w)
create materialized view log on w (x)
create materialized view mv (v, c) as select v, count(*) from t group by v
create materialized view mv2 (v, c) as select v, count(*) from t group by v
create materialized view mvu (w, c) as select w, count(*) from u group by w
create materialized view mvw (x, c) as select x, count(*) from w group by x
